title: “I Cannot Write This Because It Violates Our Content Policy”: Understanding Content Moderation Policies and User Experiences in Generative AI Products

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of public Reddit discussions to identify user-reported false positives, context-blind over-censorship, and algorithmic inconsistencies when generating harmless creative content (e.g., fictional violence, artistic nudity).

Analysis of user feedback on Reddit highlighting instances where LLMs force overly positive narratives, sanitize writing, or refuse to generate debatable topics in creative writing due to safety fine-tuning.

Qualitative extraction of user complaints on Reddit noting inconsistent moderation enforcement for different high-profile political or public figures, which users attribute to implicit rules or developer bias.
